description: An iconic pyramid-shaped mountain in the Alps on the border of Switzerland and Italy, famous for its dramatic profile and for inspiring the Toblerone design.
A picturesque lakeside village in Austria known for its alpine scenery, historic salt production, and postcard-like views.
A stunning Arctic archipelago in northern Norway known for sharp mountain peaks, fishing villages, and excellent chances to see the northern lights.
Mount Kilimanjaro is Africa's highest mountain and a famous free-standing volcano with snow-capped peaks near the equator.
The largest religious monument in the world, Angkor Wat is a remarkable temple complex originally built in the 12th century.
